title: Preferences for Advisor Agreement and Accuracy

participants.population: Online adult participants recruited through Prolific

demographics.note: The authors deliberately did not collect demographic data.

design.type: mixed design with repeated judgments and a between-participant feedback condition

attention_checks.failure_action: terminate participant and preserve failed record

steps: Randomize the public question bank without replacement for each participant.
Assign the participant to feedback/no-feedback and one of two advisor orders.
Run 10 unaided practice trials and reveal the correct year after each response.
Run 2 practice-with-advice trials using the separate correct Practice advisor and reveal the correct year after each final response.
Run 15 familiarisation slots with the first advisor and 15 with the second advisor.
Replace global trial indices 16 and 36 with attention checks requiring the smallest marker to cover a stated year; terminate immediately on failure.
On every trial, collect an initial year estimate and marker width.
Generate a six-year-wide advisor marker from the advisor's hidden policy.
Collect a final year estimate and marker width while preserving the initial estimate and advice in context.
In Experiment 3C, reveal the correct year only after the final estimate; in Experiment 3B, do not reveal it during the task.
Run 10 test trials in which the participant chooses one of the two anonymous advisors after the initial estimate and before receiving advice.

runtime.group_semantics: custom stateful participant runner; participants are independent and may run in parallel
